idea-plugin.name: Redline - Rendered HTML Diff
idea-plugin.description:
Review HTML and Markdown changes as a rendered document. When both sides are HTML or Markdown, Redline adds a viewer that shows the page as the browser renders it, with insertions and deletions highlighted inline — legal-document style.

Prose edits in long hand-authored lines, renumbered lists, and table changes become readable at a glance instead of a wall of rewrapped markup. Works anywhere the IDE shows a diff: local changes, commits, and VCS revisions.

Review attribute changes with amber outlines and tooltips, and jump between changes using the navigation controls and minimap. Switch between Original, Redline, and Final while preserving each side's text, attributes, and list/table whitespace.

Select the Redline viewer in the diff editor's view switcher, next to Side-by-side and Unified.
